A renderer can use this texture to create reflections on surfaces with metallic materials.
A renderer can use this texture to create diffuse lighting effects.

The side of an object rendered with a reflective material would show a hard line between red and blue, but a diffuse material should appear purple, because the side of the object receives a blend of the red light from above and the blue light from below.
You can use reflective and irradiance textures with the class.
